description:
We're 4 ambitious undergrad students from the best university our country has to offer, NUST, and we're partaking in this year's NASA Space Apps Challenge to hone our skills, get our name out there, along with hopefully getting to meet some amazing people!

We're mostly skilled in RAG AI, Frontend, Backend, and Animations.

Looking forward to the hackathon, and see you all there!
summary: We built a software (using chatgpt, and claude) that compares the input values against their preflight baseline for each astronaut, and gives personalized suggestions.
